related_questions.question: Does the hospital admit you for COVID?
related_questions.snippet: Key takeaways: Most people with COVID-19 infections don't need to go to the hospital and will have a smooth recovery at home. Severe COVID symptoms that need medical attention include difficulty breathing, confusion or disorientation, and a bluish discoloration in the lips or hands.

related_questions.question: What do hospitals do with COVID patients?
related_questions.snippet: What happens when you go to the hospital largely depends on the severity of your symptoms. Some patients require minimal intervention, while others need ventilators to help them breathe. Although there is no cure, treatment may include antivirals, steroids, antibiotics or convalescent plasma, among many other methods.
